paragraphs.en: Last Friday was a terrible day for Dilshod. He woke up late, so he didn't have breakfast. He ran to the bus stop and caught the bus just in time.
paragraphs.uz: O'tgan juma Dilshod uchun dahshatli kun bo'ldi. U kech uyg'ondi, shuning uchun nonushta qilmadi. Bekatga yugurdi va avtobusga zo'rg'a ulgurdi.

paragraphs.en: At university, he wanted to call his mother, but his phone wasn't in his pocket. It wasn't in his bag either. "Oh no! I left it on the bus!" he thought.
paragraphs.uz: Universitetda u onasiga qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin telefoni cho'ntagida yo'q edi. Sumkasida ham yo'q edi. "Voy! Uni avtobusda qoldirdim!" deb o'yladi u.

paragraphs.en: He borrowed his friend's phone and called his own number. Nobody answered. He felt very worried — all his photos and notes were on that phone.
paragraphs.uz: U do'stining telefonini olib, o'z raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qildi. Hech kim javob bermadi. U juda xavotirlandi — barcha suratlari va yozuvlari o'sha telefonda edi.

paragraphs.en: In the evening, he called again. This time, a woman answered. "Hello! I found this phone on bus number 51," she said. "I'm a nurse at the city hospital. You can come and get it tomorrow."
paragraphs.uz: Kechqurun u yana qo'ng'iroq qildi. Bu safar bir ayol javob berdi. "Salom! Men bu telefonni 51-avtobusda topdim," dedi u. "Men shahar kasalxonasida hamshiraman. Ertaga kelib olib ketishingiz mumkin."

paragraphs.en: The next morning, Dilshod went to the hospital with a big box of chocolates. He thanked the nurse many times. "There are still good people in the world," he told his mother later.
paragraphs.uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab Dilshod katta quti shokolad bilan kasalxonaga bordi. Hamshiraga ko'p marta rahmat aytdi. "Dunyoda hali ham yaxshi odamlar bor," dedi u keyinroq onasiga.

questions.q: Where did he leave his phone?
What did Dilshod give the woman?
